label: Generate a daily quote or joke with OpenAI and email it
description: This workflow prompts OpenAI for an inspirational quote on weekdays and a joke on the weekends. The quote is enriched with some context. Afterwards, the joke or the quote is sent via email.

triggers.description: Starts the workflow every day at 08:00 London time. The run's date and time are passed on to the weekend check.
triggers.label: Daily
triggers.name: trigger_1

tasks.description: Checks whether the trigger's date falls on a Saturday or Sunday (London time) and returns true or false. The next step uses this to choose between a joke and a quote.
tasks.label: Check if its the weekend
tasks.name: dateHelper_1

tasks.description: Routes the run on the weekend check. True (weekend) runs the joke branch; false (weekday) runs the quote branch.
tasks.label: Quote or a joke
tasks.name: condition_1

caseFalse.description: Weekday branch: asks OpenAI for a real inspirational quote and returns its author, the quote text and some historical context as JSON.
caseFalse.label: Generate a quote
caseFalse.name: openAi_2

parameters.userPrompt: Give me an inspirational quote with an author and the quote text, also the context for the quote - like a historical event, a speech where the quote occurred, or how its used today.
parameters.systemPrompt: The output should be JSON, with an author, quote, context properties. Make sure the quote is an actual human quote.

caseFalse.description: Weekday branch: emails the quote, with the author in the subject and the quote plus its context as the body. Set the recipient address in the To field.
caseFalse.label: Send the quote
caseFalse.name: googleMail_2

parameters.subject: Here's a quote by ${openAi_2.author}

caseTrue.description: Weekend branch: asks OpenAI for a real joke and returns its setup and punchline as JSON.
caseTrue.label: Generate a joke
caseTrue.name: openAi_1

parameters.userPrompt: Give me a joke with a setup and punchline
parameters.systemPrompt: The output should be JSON, with a setup and punchline properties. Make sure the joke is an actual human joke.

caseTrue.description: Weekend branch: emails the joke, with the setup in the subject and the punchline as the body. Set the recipient address in the To field.
caseTrue.label: Send the joke
caseTrue.name: googleMail_1
